clue.text: The language, when actors robe with difficulty!

indicators.note: doing something with difficulty suggests a struggle, so the letters of these two words are wrestled into a new order

explanation.surface: An exclamation about what language is spoken when actors struggle into their robes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with difficulty' rearranges the ten letters of ACTORS ROBE.
explanation.definitionFit: Serbo-Croat is the South Slavic tongue of the former Yugoslavia, a language in its own right.

clue.text: Arrogance seen initially in sporting teams

parts.note: side, in an old British sense, is a haughty, superior manner, as in 'putting on side'

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word seen that it follows

explanation.surface: Someone notices arrogance among sports teams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes S from 'seen'. SIDE meaning swagger or pretentiousness is British usage ('no side about him').
explanation.definitionFit: Teams lined up against each other in a match are the two opposing elevens or fifteens.

clue.text: Uproar always made by a mobster

parts.note: a racket is a loud din or commotion
e'er is the poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A gangster is constantly causing a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A racketeer runs criminal extortion schemes, so is a gangster or hoodlum.

clue.text: Ace gunman taking money in the arcade?

parts.note: an ace is the one in a pack of cards
a gunman is a bandit carrying a weapon

explanation.surface: A crack shot holds up an amusement arcade for its takings.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive: a fruit machine in a gaming hall swallows coins, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A slot machine with a lever pull is nicknamed for robbing players of their coins in gaming halls.

clue.text: Discern materials set aside

indicators.note: materials are things worked up into something else, so the word discern is the raw stuff remade into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone works out which materials to put aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'materials' is an unusual anagram signal: the letters of DISCERN are the raw material rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescind a law or decision is to revoke or annul it, setting it aside.

clue.text: Like one with a nervous spasm of continental origin

parts.note: as means like, in the same way as
the Roman numeral for one is I
a tic is an involuntary twitch of the muscles

explanation.surface: Describing someone with a twitchy nervous habit, born on another continent.
explanation.definitionFit: Asiatic means coming from Asia, the largest continent.

clue.text: Wounding remark pointedly made in a wire

definitions.meaning: a cutting, hurtful jibe aimed at someone
the sharp spike twisted into fencing wire

explanation.definitionFit: A cutting jibe and a spike on fencing wire share the one word, both being sharp points meant to hurt.

clue.text: An old tribesman's point of view

definitions.meaning: a member of the Germanic people who settled England with the Saxons
a standpoint or slant on a subject

explanation.definitionFit: One of the ancient Germanic settlers of England, and a perspective or slant taken on a story.

clue.text: Behind time (delayed in bed? Extremely likely)

indicators.note: in means the word for delayed sits inside the word bed

parts.note: taken as it is
delayed means late

indicators.note: extremely points to the extreme, that is first and last, letters of the word likely

explanation.surface: A parenthetical explanation of lateness: probably held up by lying in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts LATE inside BED, and 'Extremely' gives LY, the first and last letters of 'likely'.
explanation.definitionFit: Done belatedly means arriving tardily, after the due moment.

clue.text: Such undercover operations do lack danger, perhaps, when involving a horse

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters given are only one possible arrangement, so they are to be reshuffled

parts.note: gee is a horse in nursery talk, and gee is also the spoken name of the letter G

explanation.surface: Spy work supposedly avoids risk, at least when a horse is involved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges DO LACK DANGER with A and G (gee, a horse, is also the letter's name); 'when involving' just brings those extra letters in.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloak-and-dagger describes secret, spy-thriller style intrigue.

clue.text: Costermonger's wife with an aversion to sneezing?

definitions.text: Costermonger's wife with an aversion to sneezing?

parts.words: Costermonger's wife with an aversion to sneezing
parts.note: a London street trader calls his wife 'my old Dutch', and a noblewoman who shuns a sneeze's 'choo' plays on the word

explanation.surface: A street trader's spouse who cannot bear sneezes.
explanation.walkthrough: A costermonger is a London barrow-boy selling fruit; Cockneys call a wife 'my old Dutch', from the noble title. The sneezing joke recalls Alice in Wonderland's peppery kitchen scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockney slang for a wife comes from the title of a peer's wife, shortened to 'Dutch'.

clue.text: About a generation back, a sick student would be banned

parts.note: ill means sick

indicators.note: back means the word for generation is read in reverse

parts.note: an age is a generation or era
L is the learner plate, so a student

explanation.surface: Roughly a generation ago, an ill student would have been barred.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns AGE into EGA. 'About' is part of the surface reading of a rough date.
explanation.definitionFit: Something illegal is prohibited by law, so forbidden.

clue.text: Skewer in brand-new condition used in cooking

parts.note: to skewer is to spear
in mint condition means as new

explanation.surface: A kebab skewer, as good as new, put to use in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Spearmint is a herb added to food in the kitchen, as in mint sauce.

clue.text: Lively as the French in paintings and sculpture

indicators.note: in places the French article inside the word for the visual arts

parts.note: art covers painting and sculpture
le is French for the

explanation.surface: French artworks described as vibrant.
explanation.definitionFit: Alert means quick, wide awake and sprightly.

clue.text: The chief magistrate is a flighty female

definitions.meaning: the chief officer of a town or district in Anglo-Saxon England
the female of the ruff, a wading bird

explanation.definitionFit: An old English shire officer, and the hen of the ruff, a bird that flies, hence 'flighty'.

clue.text: Edible product of Cape, more fully developed outside

indicators.note: outside puts the word for more fully developed around the rearranged letters

parts.note: riper means more mature

indicators.note: a product is something worked up from raw stuff, so the word Cape is remade

explanation.surface: Something edible made in the Cape, more mature on the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'product of' rearranges CAPE into CEPA, and 'outside' puts RIPER around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Rice paper is thin edible sheet used in baking and spring rolls, so the name describes something you can eat.

clue.text: Recited act covering land allotted for mining

indicators.note: covering means the word for act wraps around the mining term

parts.note: a deed is an act
a claim is a plot staked out by a prospector

explanation.surface: Legislation over mining plots was read aloud formally.
explanation.definitionFit: To declaim is to deliver a speech or poem rhetorically.

clue.text: Small fraction a Scottish philosopher hit on, oddly enough

parts.note: James Mill was a Scottish philosopher and economist, father of John Stuart Mill

indicators.note: oddly suggests the words hit on are in a strange order

explanation.surface: A thinker from Scotland stumbled on a tiny portion, strangely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly enough' rearranges HIT ON into IONTH.
explanation.definitionFit: One part in a million is a very tiny proportion.

clue.text: Sea cruise initiated by a woman head?

indicators.note: initiated means just the start of the word cruise

parts.note: Eve was made from Adam's rib, so rib is a jocular word for a woman or wife
bean is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A voyage on the sea, set up by a female boss?
explanation.walkthrough: 'initiated' gives C, the start of 'cruise'. RIB for woman alludes to Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: The Caribbean is the body of water between Central America and the West Indies.

clue.text: Send me up a couple to adopt

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word me is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a brace is a pair, as of game birds

explanation.surface: A request to mock me, plus a pair taken on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Send ... up' reads ME upwards as EM; 'Send' just completes the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea or cause is to take it up willingly.

clue.text: Offensive rumour about one man's origins

indicators.note: about means the word for rumour goes around the other letters

parts.note: noise can mean talk or rumour, as in making noises

indicators.note: origins means the first letters of the words one and man's

explanation.surface: Unpleasant gossip concerning a person's background.
explanation.walkthrough: 'origins' gives O and M, which 'about' places inside NOISE.
explanation.definitionFit: Noisome means foul-smelling or disgusting, hence objectionable.

clue.text: Sport with many a confederate

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
an ally is a confederate or partner

explanation.surface: Playing alongside lots of partners.
explanation.definitionFit: To dally with someone is to toy or flirt with them.

clue.text: Crustacean from river caught by man on board

indicators.note: caught by means the river abbreviation is held inside the chess piece

parts.note: a pawn is a piece on a chessboard
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A shellfish pulled from a river by a crewman on a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'man on board' looks nautical but is a chessman.
explanation.definitionFit: A prawn is a small edible shellfish with ten legs.

clue.text: Set of characters losing wager to a bright star

indicators.note: losing means the word for a wager is removed from the longer word

parts.note: an alphabet is a set of letters
a bet is a wager

explanation.surface: A gambler loses a bet on a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomers label the brightest star of a constellation with the first Greek letter.

clue.text: Officer has ship's prison aired for a change

parts.note: a brig is a naval lock-up

indicators.note: for a change means the letters of aired are altered

explanation.surface: A military man has the ship's cells ventilated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' rearranges AIRED into ADIER.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigadier is a senior army rank, commanding a brigade.

clue.text: French coin with king on both sides to make a come-back

parts.note: R stands for rex, Latin for king
the ecu was an old French coin
R stands for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: An old French coin with a monarch's head on each face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on both sides' means R goes on each side of ECU.
explanation.definitionFit: To recur is to happen again, returning after a gap.

clue.text: Condiment obtained from island in state park, maybe

indicators.note: in means the letter for island goes inside the rest

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania

indicators.note: maybe suggests the word park in some other order

parts.note: I is the map abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A seasoning sourced from an island in a national park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges PARK into PRKA, and 'in' puts I inside PA + PRKA.
explanation.definitionFit: Paprika is a red powdered spice from peppers.

clue.text: It is vital to be constitutional

definitions.meaning: relating to the bodily organs, essential to life
fundamental, part of the basic structure

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers living bodily processes and things inherent in a structure's basic make-up.

clue.text: Genuine old Spanish coin

definitions.meaning: a former silver coin of Spain

explanation.definitionFit: Authentic, and the name of a silver piece once minted in Spain.

clue.text: Maker of scientific investigation about a Kentish bowman?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Kent is in the south-east of England, SE
an archer shoots with a bow

explanation.surface: A man from Kent who is good with a bow.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in South-East England, so Kentish gives SE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who carries out scientific inquiries is an investigator in a lab.
